identity: the EXACT same character as the reference full-body character sheet (first reference is the master design, match it precisely; second reference is face and hair detail). framing: Chat sticker. Upper body from head to waist, character centered, face large and readable (about 35% of frame), clear silhouette with some margin. Clean cel-shaded anime illustration, crisp line art, readable at small sticker size.
background: Background: perfectly flat solid pure chroma green #00FF00, no gradient, no floor, no scenery, no shadows on background, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. Only one girl in the image; small non-human companions are allowed.
spirit: a tiny chibi translucent icy-blue water-spirit otter (her spirit companion, about the size of her head)
video: Anime chat sticker loop, flat solid green background, locked camera, no zoom. {m} Hair, water scarf and sheer sleeves follow the motion with soft inertia and settle. Keep her face, outfit and accessories exactly unchanged. She returns to the exact starting pose at the end. The camera stays locked on the same upper-body framing as the first frame for the whole clip: never zoom out, never pull back, never reveal her legs. Effects stay small and close to her, never filling the background. No green-colored effects or light. Lively expressive anime timing, background stays flat green, no text.

items.m: The alarm clock rings and shakes, she panics, lightning bolts flash, she clutches it tighter sweating.

items.s: Expression: triumphant relieved grin. Pose: snapping a book shut with one hand, fist raised with the other. Symbols: a big golden check mark and sparkles.
items.m: She snaps the book shut, raises her fist, a big check mark stamps in with sparkles, she exhales happily.

items.s: Expression: thoughtful reflective eyes. Pose: holding an open notebook, finger tracing back up the lines. Symbols: a circular rewind arrow.
items.m: Her finger traces back up the notebook lines, the rewind arrow spins backward, she nods thoughtfully.

items.s: Expression: quick eager focus. Pose: scribbling fast with a pencil on a small spiral notepad. Symbols: small star marks and check sparkles.
items.m: She scribbles rapidly, flips the page, check sparkles pop on the pad.

items.s: Expression: curious eager face, eyebrows raised. Pose: one hand raised high to ask a question. Symbols: a big question mark speech bubble. Exactly two arms: her other hand rests on her chest, clearly visible.
items.m: She tilts her head curiously with her raised hand waving slightly, her other hand stays on her chest. The question-mark speech bubble stays beside her head the whole clip, bobbing gently.

items.s: Expression: eureka excitement, eyes wide and sparkling, mouth open. Pose: one finger pointing up. Symbols: a glowing light bulb above her head with flash rays.
items.m: Her eyes widen, the light bulb flicks on with a flash, she points up excitedly.

items.s: Expression: organized confident smile. Pose: holding a clipboard checklist and a pen. Symbols: check stars lighting up one by one.
items.m: She ticks items on the clipboard with the pen, check stars light up one after another, she nods.

items.s: Expression: confident professional explaining face, mouth open mid-sentence. Pose: standing beside a small presentation whiteboard on an easel that shows a simple bar chart and pie chart (no text), tapping the chart with a slim pointer stick. Companions: two tiny chibi translucent icy-blue water-spirit otters sit in front as the audience, one raising a paw, one nodding. Symbols: two small speech bubbles containing a chart icon and a lightbulb icon (no text, no ellipsis).
items.m: She taps the chart with the pointer stick and turns toward the audience explaining, the speech bubbles alternate popping up, the spirit otters nod and one raises its paw, she nods back.

items.s: Mood: atmospheric. Behind her (not covering her) is a soft-edged cloud-shaped patch of deep navy late-night sky with a crescent moon; outside that patch the background stays flat pure green, and nothing inside the patch is green. A warm desk-lamp glow lights her tired face from one side. Expression: exhausted, heavy eye bags, forced tired smile. Pose: holding a large coffee mug, slumped. Symbols: a small night lamp glow and a crescent moon, steam from coffee.
items.m: Her head droops then jerks awake, she sips coffee wearily, the steam curls, she sighs.

items.s: Expression: cheerful focused smile. Pose: wearing a small apron, holding a wooden spatula and a frying pan. Symbols: rising steam and food sparkles.
items.m: She flips food in the pan with the spatula, steam rises, she tastes it and smiles.

items.s: Expression: cozy content smile. Pose: holding a white porcelain coffee cup with latte art on a saucer. Symbols: rising steam and a coffee bean.
items.m: She blows on the coffee, sips, sighs contentedly, the steam curls up.

items.s: Expression: happy satisfied face sipping. Pose: holding a bubble milk tea cup with a straw. Symbols: tapioca pearls bouncing and small hearts.
items.m: She sips through the straw, pearls bounce up, her cheeks puff round as she chews happily, hearts pop. When her cheeks puff, it is correct anime form: both cheeks round outward like a hamster and the face outline bulges a little at the cheeks, lips pressed into a small pout; the mouth stays small, in its normal place and visible; never a blob or balloon in front of the mouth.

items.s: Mood: ravenous 'foodie mode ON' energy. Expression: eager hungry eyes with sparkles, cheeks stuffed round like a hamster, a grain of rice on her cheek. Pose: exactly two hands: one hand holds a big bowl heaped into a tall mountain of white rice, the other hand shovels rice with chopsticks into her mouth. Symbols: rice grains flying, speed lines, small steam puffs (white) and small white rice sparkles. No fire or flames anywhere.
items.m: She shovels rice super fast, cheeks puffed full like a hamster as she chews, rice grains fly, speed lines flicker, she chews happily with a satisfied hum, then dives in again. When her cheeks puff, it is correct anime form: both cheeks round outward like a hamster and the face outline bulges a little at the cheeks, lips pressed into a small pout; the mouth stays small, in its normal place and visible; never a blob or balloon in front of the mouth.

items.s: Expression: excited big-mouth bite face. Pose: holding a big burger with both hands. Symbols: small grease sparkle stars.
items.m: She opens wide and takes a big bite of the burger, chews happily, sparkles pop.

items.s: Expression: delighted slurping face. Pose: lifting noodles from a bowl with chopsticks. Symbols: steam and noodle sparkles.
items.m: She lifts the noodles high, blows on them, slurps them up happily, steam rises.

items.s: Expression: gentle content chewing face. Pose: holding a rice bowl close to her mouth with both hands. Symbols: glowing rice grain sparkles.
items.m: She takes small bites from the bowl and chews contentedly, rice sparkles glow.

items.s: Expression: delighted sweet tooth face, sparkling eyes. Pose: holding a small cake plate and a fork. Symbols: sugar sparkle stars and pink hearts.
items.m: She takes a bite of cake, cups her cheek in bliss, sugar sparkles and hearts pop.

items.s: Expression: fresh happy smile. Pose: holding a small plate of fresh fruits and biting a strawberry. Symbols: fresh fruit sparkles and juice sparkles.
items.m: She bites the strawberry, juice sparkles burst, she smiles freshly, fruit sparkles twirl.

items.s: Expression: serene elegant calm. Pose: pouring tea from a small teapot into a cup. Symbols: fragrant tea mist curling.
items.m: She pours the tea gracefully, fragrant mist curls up, she smells the aroma with closed eyes.

items.s: Expression: overjoyed drooling excitement, sparkling eyes. Pose: hands clasped together in front of a large plate full of delicious dishes. Symbols: golden glow over the food and drool sparkle.
items.m: She rubs her hands together excitedly, the golden glow over the food shines, she drools and grabs a bite.

items.s: Expression: munching happily, cheeks puffed. Pose: hugging an open chip bag, eating a chip. Symbols: crumbs and crunch sparkles.
items.m: She munches chips, crumbs fly, crunch sparkles pop, she reaches for another.

items.s: Expression: pitiful hungry face, a shiny drool drop at the corner of her mouth. Pose: one hand holding an empty bowl forward toward the viewer, the other hand on her stomach. Symbols: small orange wavy 'growl' lines in front of her stomach. No thought bubble.
items.m: Her stomach growls, the orange growl lines wiggle, she holds the empty bowl out pleadingly and looks up with puppy eyes, then droops.

items.s: Expression: eyes closed in bliss, tongue licking her lips. Pose: one hand on her cheek, the other hand holding a spoon with a small bite of strawberry cake on it. Symbols: small pink food hearts and sparkles.
items.m: She chews with eyes closed in bliss, hand on her cheek, small pink hearts pop. The spoon with the cake bite stays in her other hand, fully visible the whole clip.

items.s: Expression: excited adventurous smile. Pose: pulling a small suitcase handle, other hand waving. Symbols: a small airplane with a trailing cloud line.
items.m: She waves excitedly and steps forward with the suitcase, the little airplane flies across leaving a cloud trail.

items.s: Expression: determined slightly tired smile, sweat. Pose: holding a trekking pole, a small backpack on her shoulders. Symbols: a distant mountain silhouette icon and sweat drops.
items.m: She pushes forward with the trekking pole, wipes sweat, looks up toward the mountain icon with determination.

items.s: Expression: joyful summer smile. Pose: wearing a straw sun hat, holding a seashell up. Symbols: splashing water waves and droplets.
items.m: She holds her hat against the breeze, raises the seashell, waves splash and droplets sparkle.

items.s: Expression: triumphant summit joy. Pose: planting a small triangle flag pole, one fist raised. Symbols: a snowy mountain peak icon and sparkles.
items.m: She plants the flag firmly, raises her fist triumphantly, the flag flutters in the wind.

items.s: Expression: curious delighted look around. Pose: holding a small street sign arrow. Symbols: a small skyline icon of tall buildings.
items.m: She looks around amazed, points along the street sign, the skyline icon lights up with tiny sparkles.

items.s: Expression: playful wink. Pose: holding a camera up to her eye. Symbols: a camera flash sparkle.
items.m: She aims the camera, clicks, the flash bursts, she lowers it and smiles.

items.s: Expression: proud happy grin. Pose: both hands holding up a small clear gift box tied with a gold ribbon bow; inside the box is a tiny snow globe with a miniature tower. No text. No companion.
items.m: She lifts the gift box proudly toward the viewer, the snow globe inside sparkles, she grins; she never brings it to her mouth.

items.s: Expression: busy concentrated packing face. Pose: stuffing clothes into an open small suitcase. Symbols: a travel ticket and small sparkles.
items.m: She stuffs clothes in, pushes the suitcase lid down, the ticket pops up, she smiles relieved.

items.s: Mood: atmospheric. Behind her (not covering her) is a soft cloud-shaped patch with irregular fluffy edges (no hard round or arc edge) of warm orange and pink sunset sky with a red-orange sun half below a distant horizon line, no stars; outside that patch the background stays flat pure green, and nothing inside the patch is green. Expression: wistful peaceful gaze. Pose: chin resting on one hand, the other arm relaxed (exactly two arms), looking into the distance.
items.m: She gazes at the sunset, the breeze moves her hair, the sun glows warmer and sinks a little.

items.s: Expression: cozy happy smile. Pose: both hands holding a white mug of cocoa. Beside her (clearly separated from her hair) a small warm-orange and cream triangle tent and a small orange-yellow campfire; a few stars. Nothing green.
items.m: The campfire beside her flickers, she sips the cocoa warmly, small sparks float up; the tent and campfire stay visible the whole time and the flames never touch her hair.

items.s: Expression: curious searching look. Pose: holding an unfolded paper map with both hands. Symbols: a red location pin bouncing.
items.m: She scans the map, the location pin drops and bounces, she points at it with a smile.

items.s: Expression: wide happy eyes, mouth open in a cheerful 'we're here!' grin. Pose: exactly two hands: her left hand holds up a big glossy red map location pin beside her shoulder, her right hand raises a small orange triangular finish flag (blank, no text). Symbols: three small white footprints in a row that stop next to the pin, a burst of small gold stars. No arrows, no signboards. No companion.
items.m: She plants the red pin down with a little bounce and waves the orange finish flag, gold stars burst, she beams proudly.

items.s: Expression: energetic determined face, slightly flushed, panting with a small open-mouth smile, a few sweat drops. Pose: exactly two arms bent at the elbows in a running arm swing, one forearm forward and one back, both hands loosely closed, elbows inside the frame; a pink sporty headband on her forehead (keep all her usual hair accessories). Symbols: horizontal speed lines streaming behind her and small dust puffs (white). Upper-body framing only, no legs.
items.m: She swings her arms in a jogging rhythm, her body bobs up and down slightly, hair and scarf bounce behind her, speed lines stream past, she pants with a determined smile.

items.s: Expression: relaxed comfortable stretch face. Pose: one arm stretched overhead and leaning to the side. Symbols: soft flowing curved lines.
items.m: She stretches long to one side, holds it, breathes, then straightens back.

items.s: Expression: serene, eyes closed, calm smile. Pose: palms pressed together in front of her chest. Symbols: an opaque pink-and-gold lotus flower behind her head with a soft pale-pink glow only around the lotus; small floating petals. No rays, nothing green.
items.m: She breathes slowly in and out, the lotus behind her glows softly pale pink, petals drift; the lotus stays visible the whole time.

items.s: Expression: sporty excited grin. Pose: spinning a basketball on one finger. Symbols: motion sparkles around the ball. Exactly two arms: her other hand rests on her hip, clearly visible.
items.m: The ball spins on her finger, she tosses it up and catches it, sparkles fly.

items.s: Expression: overheated, face flushed red, panting with mouth open and tongue slightly out, big clear sweat drops on her forehead and cheeks, NO tears, not sad. Pose: exactly two hands, one on each side of her body: her right hand holds a round paper hand-fan fanning her face, her left hand tugs at her collar to let air in. Symbols: a small hot orange sun icon above her head, wavy ORANGE-RED heat lines, sweat drops flying off.
items.m: She fans herself frantically with the paper fan, tugs her collar, pants, big sweat drops fly off, the orange heat lines wobble, the little sun pulses hot.

items.s: Expression: recovering gentle smile, still slightly pale. Pose: wrapped in a light blanket, a small bandage on her cheek, holding a warm mug. Symbols: a soft glowing healing cross and warm light.
items.m: She sips the warm drink, the healing cross glows warmer, her cheeks regain color, she smiles.

items.s: Mood: atmospheric. Behind her (not covering her) is a soft-edged cloud-shaped patch of gloomy blue-gray rain clouds with slanted silver rain streaks; outside that patch the background stays flat pure green, and nothing inside the patch is green. Expression: flustered soaked face, wet hair strands. Pose: both hands over her head shielding from rain, shoulders hunched. Symbols: slanted rain lines and water splashes.
items.m: Rain pours on her, she hunches and shields her head, splashes bounce, she shivers.

items.s: Mood: atmospheric. Behind her (not covering her) is a soft-edged cloud-shaped patch of soft pale blue-gray winter sky with falling white snowflakes; outside that patch the background stays flat pure green, and nothing inside the patch is green. Expression: delighted wonder, mouth open. Pose: holding out her gloved palms to catch snowflakes. Symbols: falling white snowflakes.
items.m: Snowflakes drift down, she catches one on her palm and gasps happily, looks up as more fall.

items.s: Expression: squinting against the wind. Pose: holding her hair back with one hand, body leaning into the wind. Symbols: wind streak lines and a few flying orange autumn leaves and pink petals.
items.m: A strong gust blows, her hair and scarf whip sideways, she leans and holds her hair, orange leaves and pink petals fly past.

items.s: Expression: joyful birthday smile. Pose: holding a small birthday cake with lit candles. Symbols: confetti and ribbons.
items.m: She blows out the candles, confetti pops, she cheers happily.

items.s: Expression: cheering celebration. Pose: raising a glass of sparkling juice in a toast. Symbols: fireworks and gold stars.
items.m: She raises the glass in a toast, fireworks burst, gold stars shower, she cheers.

items.s: Expression: hopeful happy smile with a wink. Pose: holding up a shiny golden four-leaf-clover charm near her face. Symbols: golden lucky light sparkles.
items.m: She holds up the golden clover charm, golden lucky sparkles burst around it, she winks and smiles.
